description: Approval vectors: the threshold at request, M of N approval by distinct current approvers, repeated approvals, the single rejection veto, approver removal and the approvals_required transitions.

vectors.description: With an approval threshold of 500, a charge of 499 is APPROVED into committed while 500 and 501 are PENDING in pending.
A payout below the threshold is APPROVED on request, so an approval of it is refused with PAYOUT_WRONG_STATUS, and it executes.
Lowering the threshold keeps an earlier payout APPROVED and executable, while the same charge requested afterwards is PENDING.
With a threshold of 0 even a payout of 1 unit is PENDING until an approver approves it, and then it executes.
A 2 of 3 payout stays PENDING after one approval and becomes APPROVED at the second distinct approver, moving the charge to committed.
An approver approving again while the payout still needs more approvals is refused with ALREADY_APPROVED and nothing changes.
After approvals_required drops to 1, a repeat approval from the approver who already approved completes the payout without adding itself again.
Lowering approvals_required does not approve a waiting payout by itself; the next approval call completes it.
A 2 of 3 payout with one approval is rejected by another approver: a REJECTED tombstone, pending released, and later approvals refused.
The principal, who is not an approver, rejects a PENDING payout, which becomes a REJECTED tombstone and releases pending.
Rejection is allowed while the mandate is paused and after it expires.
An approval from an approver who is then removed stops counting: the payout needs two approvals from current approvers.
Removing one of three approvers while two approvals are required leaves enough approvers and succeeds.
Adding the first approver emits role_added and then approvals_required_set with 1, in the same call.
An agent cannot be added as the first approver (ROLE_CONFLICT), and approvals_required stays 0 until a valid approver is added.
The last approver cannot be removed while the threshold is at or below the cap; once raised it can, and a leftover PENDING payout is cancelled.
With the threshold above the cap, removing the only approver emits role_removed and then approvals_required_set with 0.
With no approvers, update_limits that keeps the threshold above the new cap succeeds.
Approving a PENDING payout at its expiry is refused with PAYOUT_LAPSED, and anyone may then cancel it.
create is CONFIG_INVALID when approvals_required does not fit the approvers, or with no approvers and the threshold at or below the cap.
An approver removed and added back holds a new epoch: its old approval no longer counts, one more approval leaves the payout pending, and its fresh approval completes it.
A re-added approver may approve again, since its old approval is not a repeat, and approving a second time under the new epoch is ALREADY_APPROVED.
